_comment: Triaged, accepted-pending-upgrade advisories. All are framework-transitive via Payload + Next. As of 2026-08-01 the tree runs Next 16.2.12 with overrides for postcss, sharp, immutable, js-yaml and fast-uri, so the previously un-allowlisted advisories are FIXED rather than accepted; the entries below are the residual ones with no compatible patch. Remediation: re-run scripts/audit-ci.mjs after each Next or Payload upgrade and delete any entry that no longer appears. Tracked in docs/SECURITY.md. Any high/critical advisory NOT listed here fails CI.

GHSA-p6gq-j5cr-w38f.title: Nodemailer: Message-level raw option bypasses disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess

GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g.title: undici vulnerable to TLS certificate validation bypass via dropped requestTls in

GHSA-vxpw-j846-p89q.title: undici WebSocket client vulnerable to denial of service via fragment count bypas

GHSA-hm92-r4w5-c3mj.title: undici vulnerable to cross-origin request routing via SOCKS5 proxy pool reuse

GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.note: Framework-transitive via payload 3.85.1. No patched release exists: latest published image-size is 2.0.2 and the advisory covers <=2.0.2. Fix requires payload 3.87.1, which regenerates the lockfile and floats 338 packages including a nodemailer 8->9 major on the SES path. Deferred as a controlled upgrade during the soak window. DoS only, no data exposure.

GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.note: Same root cause, same remediation path as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.
